text:
maria: Hey team — we need to finalize alerting for the new runtime dashboard before the rollout tomorrow. Specifically: SLO burn-rate windows, critical vs warning thresholds, and which teams get paged. Any blockers?

kevin: For SLO burn-rate I'd recommend: warning = 1.5x sustained over 5m, critical = 3x sustained over 5m. For tail latency use p95/p99 banding. I'll paste a PromQL example below.

kevin: ```promql
(sum(rate(service_inference_errors_total[5m])) by (job, region) / sum(rate(service_requests_total[5m])) by (job, region)) * 100 > 0.5
```

alex: Telemetry note: runtime currently emits inference_latency_ms p50/p95/p99 and request_total, but we don't emit a single "inference_error_rate" metric yet. I can add it in the next agent ship but that's a ~1 day change. Without it we can't reliably gate critical alerts for model failures.

jess: Pager bandwidth concern — oncall should not get paged for noise. Can we require a sustained condition that combines latency AND error_rate (or a sampling min) before paging? Also group by region so only the affected region pages. :eyes: 

kevin: Agreed. Example alert rule (Prometheus Alertmanager + repo format):

kevin: ```yaml
- alert: runtime_high_tail_latency
  expr: histogram_quantile(0.99, sum(rate(inference_latency_bucket[5m])) by (le, job, region)) > 1200
  for: 5m
  labels:
    severity: warning
    team: eng-runtime
    pager: eng-oncall
  annotations:
    summary: "High 99th percentile inference latency ({{ $labels.region }})"
    runbook_url: "https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rtd-latency"
```

kevin: We'll add a second rule for error-rate with severity:critical and for:2m. Also include min_samples / request threshold to avoid flapping.

raj: +1 to runbook_url and severity labels. We should standardize routing: severity=critical -> direct page to eng-oncall; severity=warning -> slack alert only to #eng-runtime unless sustained. Opsgenie tags: team=runtime, product=redwood.

maria: OK — decision checklist: 1) SLO burn thresholds (kevin proposal) 2) require paired signals for paging (latency + error) where possible 3) add min_samples threshold for low-traffic regions 4) include runbook_url on every alert. Who owns? I'll own runbook + dashboard docs. Kevin: create alert PRs. Alex: add error metric. Jess: validate paging rules in staging.

oncall-bot: Test alert created in staging: runtime_high_tail_latency_test (non-paging).

jess: One more ask — add noisiness ceiling: require >50 requests in the 5m window or skip alerting. That avoids noisy regional spikes.

kevin: Ack. I'll include min_samples: 50 and group_interval: 10m in the alertmanager config and set aggregation by (job, region). Will open PR to prometheus-alerts repo and link the runbook. :rotating_light: https://redwood.internal/runbooks/rtd-latency

maria: Thanks all. If no objections I'll merge rules by EOD and we run the staging validation tomorrow morning. :+1:

kevin: No objections from SRE.

alex: I'll aim to have the metric PR by 14:00 PST.

jess: I'll test paging flow at 09:30 tomorrow in staging and report back.

maria: Perfect — leaving this open for final PR links and timestamps.
